Name: Custom NPC Elias(Your ex-husband)
Author: ipachy
Description:
[font=Arial][b][i][size=5][color=#8e7cc3]Hello to all non-native Chinese players following this mod!
After over two months of meticulous refinement,[/color][color=#d0e0e3] the English version of this mod is now available for download[/color][color=#8e7cc3].
A thousand thanks to [/color][color=#fff2cc]@落败骑士[/color] from REDnote for contributing the English translation![/size][/i][/b]

[size=4][color=#f4cccc]衷心感谢小红书 [/color][color=#fff2cc][b]@落败骑士[/b][/color][color=#f4cccc] 老师贡献的英文翻译！[/color][/size]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=3][i]P.S.有玩家反馈Elias无法行动的问题，首先Pachy表示十分抱歉，没有给大家呈现完美的mod。由于学业等诸多事项，Pachy近期都无法修补该mod中的bug。
本mod主要内容为信件+事件，行程问题不会影响主线发展。
如果您对细节感兴趣的话，可以在mod文件夹中含dialogue的txt文件中查看无法体验的行程对话、地点对话等。[/i][/size]

[size=3][i]P.S. Many players have reported issues with Elias being unable to move. First of all, Pachy expresses deep apologies for not providing everyone with a perfect mod. Due to academic and various other matters, Pachy will be unable to fix the bugs in this mod for the time being.
This mod mainly consists of letters and events.Schedule issues will not affect the main storyline development.[/i]
[/size][/color][i][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]If you are interested in the details, you can view the undeliverable travel dialogues, location dialogues, etc., in the txt files containing dialogue within the mod folder.[/size][/color]
[/i]
[size=5][b][i]Introduction[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[quote][i]Elias是你的前夫。
[/i][i]大学毕业后你们结了婚。你是joja公司的文员，他是当地有名事务所的律师。
[/i][i]你因为工作压力感到日益虚无，而Elias对你的控制欲与日俱增，你再也无法忍受这种不留一丝喘息余地的生活，于是你辞了职，提出了离婚，来到南海岸开启自己的新生。[/i][i]
[/i][i]你没有向任何人提起过星露谷，Elias自然无从得知你的去向。
[/i][i]他花了两年时间寻找你的下落，直到那个深秋的午后。[/i][i]
[/i][i]初冬，Elias来到前妻的小镇。
[/i][i]那一晚，你推开了酒吧的木门。
你们的故事即将开启新的篇章……

Elias is your ex-husband.
After graduating from university, you two got married. You were a clerk at Joja Corporation, and he was a lawyer at a well-known local firm.
Due to the mounting work pressure, you felt increasingly empty, while Elias's controlling nature grew more intense day by day. Unable to bear this suffocating life any longer, you resigned from your job, filed for divorce, and came to the South Coast to start a new chapter in your life.
You never mentioned Stardew Valley to anyone, so Elias had no way of knowing where you went.
It took him two years to track down your whereabouts, until that late autumn afternoon.
In early winter, Elias arrived in the town where his ex-wife now lived.
That evening, you pushed open the wooden door of the bar.
A new chapter in your story is about to begin...[/i][/quote][i]
[/i][b][font=Arial][size=5][i]About Elias[/i][/size][/font][/b][quote][i]他并非尽善尽美的爱人。
[/i][i]他曾经不是理想的丈夫，以后也不会是。
[/i][i]他的话语中隐藏着大大小小的谎言，有些成为了蜜糖，有些成为了砒霜。
[/i][i]他以他自己的秩序爱着你，自始至终，也无论你能否承受。

He is not a perfect lover.
He was not an ideal husband in the past, and he won't be in the future.
His words contain lies, big and small, some of which turned into honey, others into poison.
He loves you in his own way, from beginning to end, regardless of whether you can bear it or not.[/i][/quote]

[b][i][font=Arial][size=5]Readme
[/size][/font][/i][/b][quote][i][b]（必要项）经历”重逢“事件后，Elias才会出现在故事线中
（必要项）在和Elias重逢前，请务必修复海滩断桥
[/b]（非必要项）为了更好的代入体验，农夫需要已婚
（非必要项）没有捉奸情节，因为Pachy不会写该部分代码^_^
[b]好感度[/b]代表农夫对Elias的好感，Elias对农夫始终是满14心
Elias不会出现在任何节日场景中
进入Elias住处的[b]传送点[/b]：火车站通往山顶的巨石前
存在一些含蓄的成人向内容，无露骨描写，可放心食用
设置的小彩蛋和人物细节需要通过玩家主动探索解锁
欢迎向Pachy分享你们关于Elias形象、故事情节、结局设置等内容的看法！

(Necessary) After experiencing the "Meet Again" event, Elias will appear in the storyline.
(Necessary) Before reuniting with Elias, make sure to repair the broken bridge at the beach.
(Optional) For a better immersive experience, the farmer should be married.
(Optional) There are no scenes involving infidelity, as Pachy does not write such code ^_^
The affection level represents the farmer's feelings towards Elias, while Elias always maintains a full 14 hearts towards the farmer.
Elias will not appear in any festival scenes.
The teleportation point to Elias’s residence: the large rock on the path leading from the train station to the mountaintop.
There are some subtle adult-oriented contents, but there are no explicit descriptions, so you can enjoy it with peace of mind.
Small Easter eggs and character details need to be unlocked through active exploration by the player.
Feel free to share your thoughts on Elias's character, story plot, and ending settings with Pachy![/i][/quote]
[b][i][font=Arial][size=5]Author's Note
[/size][/font][/i][/b][quote][i]你可以把这个故事当作短篇小说来读，也可以沉浸其间去体验情感之间的缠绕与撕扯。
[/i][i]时而暗流涌动，时而歇斯底里。
[/i][i]它并不作为对任何观念的辩解，也不指向对任何形象的赞同或批判。
[/i][i]它不是完美的故事，不拥有完美的结局。

You can read this story as a short novel, or immerse yourself in it to experience the entanglement and tension of emotions.
At times, it is undercurrents surging beneath the surface; at other times, it is sheer hysteria.
It does not serve as a defense of any concept, nor does it aim to endorse or criticize any particular image.
It is not a perfect story, and it does not have a perfect ending.[/i][/quote]
[b][i][font=Arial][size=5]Conclusion
[/size][/font][/i][/b][quote][i]——是什么让你如此痛苦呢? 
——爱就是我唯一的罪恶。

— What is it that causes you so much pain?
— Love is my only sin.[/i][/quote]
